'''Ōyamadera''' (大山寺, also read as Oyamaji, Daisenji, and Taisanji) is a {{ill|Buddhism|en|Buddhism|qid=Q748|lt=Buddhist|1=Buddhism}} {{ill|Temple|en|Temple|qid=Q44539|lt=Temple|1=Temple}}. Temples with this name exist in various locations across Japan.

== Temples ==

* {{ill|Ōyamadera (Shirosato, Ibaraki)|ja|大山寺 (茨城県城里町)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ōyamadera (Shirosato, Ibaraki)|qq=}} - A temple located in {{ill|Shirosato, Ibaraki|en|Shirosato, Ibaraki|qid=Q1203068|lt=Shirosato|1=Shirosato, Ibaraki}}, {{ill|Higashiibaraki District, Ibaraki|en|Higashiibaraki District, Ibaraki|qid=Q1154667|lt=Higashiibaraki District|1=Higashiibaraki District, Ibaraki}}, {{ill|Ibaraki Prefecture|en|Ibaraki Prefecture|qid=Q83273|lt=Ibaraki Prefecture|1=Ibaraki Prefecture}}.
* {{ill|Ōyamadera (Tochigi)|ja|大山寺 (栃木市)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ōyamadera (Tochigi)|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} - A temple located in [[:en:Tochigi, Tochigi|Tochigi City]], {{ill|Tochigi Prefecture|en|Tochigi Prefecture|qid=Q44843|lt=Tochigi Prefecture|1=Tochigi Prefecture}}.
* {{ill|Ōyamadera (Kamogawa, Chiba)|ja|大山寺 (鴨川市)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ōyamadera (Kamogawa, Chiba)|1=Ōyama-ji Temple|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q28683161}} - A temple located in {{ill|Kamogawa, Chiba|en|Kamogawa, Chiba|qid=Q387211|lt=Kamogawa City|1=Kamogawa, Chiba}}, {{ill|Chiba Prefecture|en|Chiba Prefecture|qid=Q80011|lt=Chiba Prefecture|1=Chiba Prefecture}}.

* {{ill|Ōyamadera (Iwakura, Aichi)|ja|大山寺 (岩倉市)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ōyamadera (Iwakura, Aichi)|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} - A temple located in {{ill|Iwakura, Aichi|en|Iwakura, Aichi|qid=Q648275|lt=Iwakura City|1=Iwakura, Aichi}}, {{ill|Aichi Prefecture|en|Aichi Prefecture|qid=Q80434|lt=Aichi Prefecture|1=Aichi Prefecture}}.
* {{ill|Taisan-ji (Kobe)|en|Taisan-ji (Kobe)|qid=Q3514065|lt=Taisan-ji (Kobe)|1=Taisan-ji (Kobe)}} - A [[Tendai sect|Tendai]] temple located in [[:en:Kobe, Hyōgo|Kobe City]], {{ill|Hyōgo Prefecture|en|Hyōgo Prefecture|qid=Q130290|lt=Hyōgo Prefecture|1=Hyōgo Prefecture}}. Former temple name was Ōyamadera. It was an imperial prayer temple of Empress Genmei.

* {{ill|Taisan-ji (Kamiita)|en|Taisan-ji (Kamiita)|qid=Q3514063|lt=Taisan-ji (Kamiita)|1=Taisan-ji (Kamiita)}} - A temple located in {{ill|Kamiita, Tokushima|en|Kamiita, Tokushima|qid=Q1350072|lt=Kamiita Town|1=Kamiita, Tokushima}}, {{ill|Itano District, Tokushima|en|Itano District, Tokushima|qid=Q1156025|lt=Itano District|1=Itano District, Tokushima}}, {{ill|Tokushima Prefecture|en|Tokushima Prefecture|qid=Q160734|lt=Tokushima Prefecture|1=Tokushima Prefecture}}.
